title: Scaling of the Bicoid morphogen gradient: the effect of state dependent diffusion.
authors: Chakraborty, Priya; Iyer, Shyam; Rikhy, Richa; Mitra, Mithun K; Nandi, Amitabha
one_liner_zh: 该文用状态依赖扩散模型研究果蝇Bicoid形态素梯度缩放，虽涉及蛋白扩散与核穿梭，但非TF-DNA结合互作，且无AI或分子模拟方法，仅数学建模，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: The mechanisms underlying the scaling of the Bicoid morphogen gradient in Drosophila with the embryo size is not clearly understood. We propose a model with a spatially varying diffusion coefficient along the anterior-posterior axis, that is proportional to the nearly periodic spatial distribution of the nucleo-cytoplasmic domains and alternating between regions of fast and slow diffusion. We postulate that for specific interpretation of the heterogeneous environment, where the space available for free diffusion within an energid is assumed to be proportional to the embryo size, a change in the embryo size can lead to a size-dependent scaling of the gradient lengthscale. We further study a two component model with slow and fast diffusing Bicoid, and identify this model to be equivalent to the heterogeneous diffusion model further postulating that thefast-state occupancywhich is a measure of the fraction of time spent in the fast diffusing state, should also scale with the embryo size via the energid size. Finally, we incorporate nuclear shuttling into our model to understand the effect of shuttling on the gradient lengthscale and scaling with embryo size. We argue that for the particular case where the degradation within the nucleus is low, nuclear shuttling does not perturb the Bicoid gradient. Our study suggests that spatial heterogeneity is able to generate scaling, independent of nuclear trapping. This mechanism may act in conjunction with other biological processes, to yield the experimentally observed scaling behavior of the Bicoid gradient.
abstract_zh: 果蝇中Bicoid形态发生素梯度随胚胎大小缩放的内在机制尚未明确。我们提出一个模型，其中沿前-后轴的扩散系数呈空间变化，该系数与核-质结构域的近似周期性空间分布成正比，并在快速和慢速扩散区域之间交替。我们假设，对于异质环境的特定解读，其中能量体内自由扩散可用空间假定与胚胎大小成正比，胚胎大小的变化可导致梯度长度尺度的大小依赖性缩放。我们进一步研究了一个包含慢速和快速扩散Bicoid的双组分模型，并确定该模型等同于异质扩散模型，进一步假设快速态占据率（衡量在快速扩散状态中所占时间比例的指标）也应通过能量体大小与胚胎大小成比例缩放。最后，我们将核穿梭纳入模型，以理解穿梭对梯度长度尺度及随胚胎大小缩放的影响。我们认为，在核内降解较低的特殊情况下，核穿梭不会扰动Bicoid梯度。我们的研究表明，空间异质性能够独立于核捕获产生缩放效应。这一机制可能与其他生物过程协同作用，以产生实验观察到的Bicoid梯度缩放行为。
